info.name: Noyo Carrier Carrier Mapped Field Member Transactions API

params.name: request_id
params.description: The unique identifier of the member request for which you would like to view member transaction

params.name: page_size
params.description: The max size of each page of results

params.name: offset

items.docs: Returns a list of all member transactions for a given member request.

info.name: Get a list of all Member Transactions

params.name: page_size
params.description: The max size of each page of results

params.name: offset
params.description: The integer offset at which to start the page. Possible values are 0 to total_records - 1

params.name: ids
params.description: Comma-separated member transaction IDs you would like to view

params.name: status_details
params.description: Comma-separated list of status details to be filtered on

params.name: current_status_detail
params.description: indicates whether the filter should operate on the current status detail or the entire history of status details

params.name: carrier_ids
params.description: Comma-separated list of carrier IDs to be filtered on

params.name: transaction_type
params.description: Transaction type of the member transaction

params.name: transaction_min_date
params.description: Earliest date that the transaction was created

params.name: transaction_max_date
params.description: Latest date that the transaction was created

params.name: status_detail_min_date
params.description: Earliest date that the transaction entered the given status detail(s)

params.name: status_detail_max_date
params.description: Latest date that the transaction entered the given status detail(s)

items.docs: Returns a list of all member transactions

params.name: transaction_id
params.description: The unique identifier of the member transaction you would like to view

items.docs: Returns the latest version of a single member transaction based on the ID provided.

info.name: Get a Case for a Member Transaction

items.docs: Returns a case if one exists for the member transaction based on the ID provided.
